name: ChatBotKit
description: ChatBotKit is a comprehensive platform designed to help businesses and developers create, manage, and deploy chatbots with ease. It offers a range of tools and features to build intelligent conversational agents that can enhance customer interaction and automate support tasks.

events.d: Add a new text record to the selected dataset.
Start a conversation with initial messages; optionally attach a contact, task, space, or bot.
Create a dataset to train or update your chatbot
Add a knowledge record to a dataset so the chatbot can find relevant answers.
